people.bio_note: Founder and CEO of One Wealth Capital Management. Started in financial services and insurance one day before his eighteenth birthday; built an 'ultra-high-touch' client philosophy; 27 years of industry experience. Employment history: MassMutual Life (Insurance Agent, since 02/2020), Guardian Life Insurance Company, and Park Avenue Securities; CEO of One Wealth since 11/2023. Holds Arizona/California insurance licenses plus Series 63 and 65; Finseca member since December 2021.
people.bio_source: Confirmed via SEC IAPD individual record / BrokerCheck report for CRD 2706452 (adviserinfo.sec.gov/individual/summary/2706452; files.brokercheck.finra.org/individual/individual_2706452.pdf) — independent regulatory filings distinct from the firm's own website, detailing employment history, licenses, and Finseca membership date.
people.phase4_note: Phase 4 verification (2026-07-03): MassMutual/Guardian Life/Park Avenue Securities employment history independently confirmed via SEC IAPD/BrokerCheck. However, the 'started one day before his 18th birthday' detail and Finseca membership date are only on the firm's own site, not the SEC record. Also, IAPD shows his CEO registration around 4-5/2024, not the bio's stated 11/2023 -- a minor date discrepancy worth a second look before outreach cites a specific start date. Verdict: PARTIAL.
